[LCST.4.1.2] **One target terminal — no type/unit split.** `TYPE_SYM` is a **single**
terminal over the type-symbol character class — `XID` plus the small non-`XID` unit-glyph
set (e.g. `°`, `%`) — valid only in type positions ([LGRA]) so non-`XID` glyphs
never enter identifiers. The compiler must resolve `TYPE_SYM` in the **type namespace**
([LGRA]). There is **no** separate `UNIT_SYM` alternative and no overlapping-terminal
choice: units resolve as types.
